transfer_taxes.name: Massachusetts deeds excise (tax stamps)
transfer_taxes.source_title: Mass DOR Directive 95-4: Enforcement of the Deeds Excise; Salem Deeds excise page; M.G.L. c.64D s.1
transfer_taxes.notes: $2.28 per $500 of consideration (= $2 per $500 under c.64D s.1 plus 14% surcharge) = $4.56 per $1,000; consideration excludes liens/encumbrances remaining at sale; applies above $100. DOR: 'paid by the person who makes or signs the deed' (grantor/seller). Barnstable County differs ($1.71 per $500). Corroborating: https://salemdeeds.com/SalemDeeds/fees_excise.aspx and https://malegislature.gov/Laws/GeneralLaws/PartI/TitleIX/Chapter64D/Section1. No Boston city transfer tax found. No mortgage tax. No primary-residence exemption.
